description: This file defines the NodeServiceManager enum with static methods for starting and stopping a node service, executing commands related to the node service, and parsing command responses. It includes extensions for internal utility functions and test methods.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Holds the result of executing a command, including success status, payload data, message, and parsed JSON response.

classes.name: ParsedServiceJson
classes.description: Represents the parsed JSON output from the node service command, including various fields like message, result, error, and hints.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the node service, returning an error message if failed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the node service, returning an error message if failed.

methods.name: serviceCommand
methods.description: Builds the command array to execute for the node service, ensuring it runs locally.

methods.name: runServiceCommandResult
methods.description: Executes the node service command with given arguments and returns a CommandResult.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Determines if an error message should be returned based on CommandResult and certain conditions.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures the command argument list includes the '--json' flag.

methods.name: parseServiceJson
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string output from the service into a ParsedServiceJson object.

methods.name: mergeHints
methods.description: Merges error message and hints into a single string for better error reporting.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of a given text to provide a concise message.
